from pathlib import Path
import base64,gzip,subprocess,os,sys,shutil

ROOT=Path.cwd()

def run(*args, check=True):
    print('+', ' '.join(args), flush=True)
    return subprocess.run(args, check=check, text=True)

def patch(data_b64, message, lint):
    data=gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(data_b64))
    p=ROOT/'.thirteenth-round.patch'
    p.write_bytes(data)
    run('git','apply','--check',str(p))
    run('git','apply',str(p))
    p.unlink()
    for f in lint:
        run('php','-l',f)
    run('git','add','-A')
    run('git','commit','-m',message)

run('git','config','user.name','File 01 Thirteenth Review')
run('git','config','user.email','actions@users.noreply.github.com')
